headline: What does the China reset mean for the Nike business?
summary: Investing.com -- Nike Inc’s China operating margins should improve 200 basis points in fiscal 2027 to 24%, well above Wall Street’s forecast of roughly flat margins year-over-year, as the sportswear giant eliminates partner-operated online storefronts and exits discounted wholesale channels, Bernstein analysts said in a recent note.
